code: library(sf)  parks <- nyc_osm_areas(borough = "Manhattan") |>   filter(leisure == "park") |>   collect() |>   nyc_osm_to_sf()  buildings <- nyc_osm_buildings(borough = "Manhattan") |>   select(osm_id, geometry) |>   collect() |>   nyc_osm_to_sf()  cycleways <- nyc_osm_lines(borough = "Manhattan") |>   filter(highway == "cycleway" | cycleway %in% c("lane", "track")) |>   collect() |>   nyc_osm_to_sf()  cafes <- nyc_osm_points(borough = "Manhattan") |>   filter(amenity == "cafe") |>   collect() |>   nyc_osm_to_sf()  ggplot() +   geom_sf(data = buildings, fill = "gray85", color = NA) +   geom_sf(data = parks, fill = "#7fbf7b", color = NA) +   geom_sf(data = cycleways, color = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.4) +   geom_sf(data = cafes, color = "#b2182b", size = 0.6) +   coord_sf(     xlim = c(978000, 992000),     ylim = c(191000, 206000),     crs = 2263,     datum = NA   ) +   labs(     title = "Lower Manhattan: parks, cycleways, and cafés",     caption = "Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)."   ) +   theme_void()

title: OpenStreetMap layers for New York City — nyc_osm
text: nyc_osm_points(): tagged nodes: points interest (amenities, shops, restaurants), transit stops, crossings, street furniture, trees, . 701,481 rows, 35 columns. nyc_osm_lines(): open ways: streets, footways, cycleways, rail, waterways, barriers. 471,643 rows, 26 columns. nyc_osm_buildings(): closed ways multipolygon relations building tag. 1,089,132 rows, 22 columns. nyc_osm_areas(): closed ways multipolygon relations: land use, parks, leisure, water, natural features, amenity areas parking lots school grounds. 202,990 rows, 27 columns. nyc_osm_routes(): route relations: bicycle, bus, train, subway, road, hiking, ferry, routes. 2,426 rows, 13 columns. Use dplyr verbs filter, select, summarise, call dplyr::collect() bring results R memory, nyc_osm_to_sf() convert sf object. pull OSM tags tags columns, use nyc_osm_add_tags(). Columns. Every layer columns: osm_type OSM element type: "node", "way", "relation" (character). osm_id OSM element ID (double). IDs unique within element type, key osm_type osm_id together. element https://www.openstreetmap.org/<osm_type>/<osm_id>. name, ... selection common OSM tags, one column per tag, listed (character). Column names tag keys : replaced _, e.g. addr:street addr_street. Values entered OSM: NA means tag absent. Numeric-looking tags height, lanes, building:levels text, OSM values can include units lists (e.g. "12 m", "2;3"). tags OSM tags element, DuckDB MAP key value. collecting, list column data frames columns key value. borough Borough feature: "Manhattan", "Bronx", "Brooklyn", "Queens", "Staten Island" (character). borough containing point feature's surface; buildings areas cross borough line, borough holding largest share polygon's area. Boroughs nycmaps::nyc_boros_sf, follow legal boundaries, features differ address: piers built Brooklyn shore East River, example, Manhattan. NA features within 500 ft buffer borough, e.g. Ellis Island New Jersey Nassau County. osm_extract Date OSM extract, 2026-10-18 (Date). geometry Geometry EPSG:2263 (NAD83 / New York Long Island, US feet), WKB (raw vector, list column collecting). Points nyc_osm_points(); LineStrings nyc_osm_lines(); MultiPolygons buildings areas; MultiLineStrings routes. Tag columns layer: points: name, amenity, shop, cuisine, highway, public_transport, railway, leisure, tourism, natural, barrier, man_made, office, craft, healthcare, emergency, historic, place, brand, operator, opening_hours, website, phone, wheelchair, addr_housenumber, addr_street, addr_postcode, ref, wikidata. lines: name, highway, service, footway, cycleway, surface, lanes, maxspeed, oneway, bridge, tunnel, layer, railway, waterway, barrier, access, bicycle, foot, ref, wikidata. buildings: name, building, building_levels, height (metres, OSM convention), nycdoitt_bin (NYC Building Identification Number, import city building footprints; joins bin nycbuildings package), addr_housenumber, addr_street, addr_postcode, amenity, shop, leisure, tourism, historic, man_made, office, wikidata. areas: name, amenity, shop, leisure, landuse, natural, water, tourism, historic, sport, man_made, office, boundary, admin_level, aeroway, military, place, addr_housenumber, addr_street, addr_postcode, wikidata. routes: name, route, ref, network, operator, colour, wikidata. tags mean documented OSM wiki, e.g. https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity. Coverage. Features bounding box -74.26, 40.49, -73.69, 40.92 within 500 feet borough boundary nycmaps::nyc_boros_sf, shoreline, pier, bridge features kept. Points nodes least one tag source, created_by, similar. Polygons closed ways tag implies area (e.g. building, landuse, leisure, amenity) multipolygon relations; polygon building tag buildings layer. Storage. Buildings stored one file per borough (plus one features outside boroughs); nyc_osm_buildings() reads single table, borough argument reads files needed. Files sorted along Hilbert curve, spatial filters nearby features read little data. OSM official sources. OSM edited volunteers. authoritative NYC building footprints, streets, boundaries, see nycbuildings, nyclion/nycstreets, nycmaps packages. OSM buildings NYC imported city's footprints, building types, levels, names added since. OSM adds points interest, footways cycleways, transit stops routes, land use, natural features. Licence. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0. See https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. bundled data database derived OSM also ODbL.
